test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The orator gave his best __winsome__ smile.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e.** 'Repelling'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"winsome" **describes someone or something that is attractive, charming, or appealing.(मनोहारी/प्रीतिपूर्ण)
 
• **In the given sentence,** the orator gave his best winsome smile, indicating that he presented a smile that was captivating and appealing.
 
• **'Repelling' **means driving away, causing aversion or dislike.(विकर्षक/भाव उत्पीड़न करनेवाला)
 
• So, the **most appropriate antonym** of the underlined word **"winsome"** is 3) Repelling.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Repelling'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) 'Cunning'** refers to being clever or sly.(चालाकी/चतुर)
 
• **Option 2) 'Satisfying' **means fulfilling or gratifying.(संतोषजनक)
 
• **Option 4) 'Winning'** can be associated with being successful or achieving victory.(विजयी/जीतने वाला)

79:T701,

The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e. 'BCDA.'</strong&
